result.question: How did Abishai rescue David when he was weary?
result.answer: He struck and killed Ishbi-benob, the Philistine who intended to kill David.
result.reason: The window directly states that the exhausted David was targeted by Ishbi-benob and that Abishai came to David’s aid by striking and killing the Philistine. Removing the unsupported label “giant” keeps the intended fact faithful to the source.
